ImageAcquisitionProtocol: data was acquired using a 1310nm swept-source OCT system with polarization sensitivity; acquisition was performed in a snake-by-rows pattern ordered left-down; acquisition was performed with a 2.8mm step size in X direction and 2.8mm step size in Y direction; tissue imaged was still on the tissue block and not sliced until after acquisition
OtherAcquisitionParameters: Array order is [spectral sample (1152, k-space), A-line (2 x 350: channel 1 co-polarization, then channel 2 cross-polarization; fast axis, X), B-scan (350; slow axis, Y)]
